title: Reception of the RRCReconfiguration by the UE

entities.name: RRCReconfiguration
entities.description: RRC message used to reconfigure UE parameters and configurations during handover or reconfiguration procedures.

entities.name: RRC reconfiguration procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by the UE to apply configuration changes specified in the RRCReconfiguration message.

entities.name: Default L1 parameter values
entities.description: Default physical layer parameter values specified in corresponding physical layer specifications, except for parameters with values provided in SIB1.

entities.name: Default MAC Cell Group configuration
entities.description: Default MAC Cell Group configuration as specified in TS 38.331 clause 9.2.2.

entities.name: System Information Block 1
entities.description: System Information Block containing essential cell access parameters and configuration information.

entities.name: Intra-system inter-RAT handover
entities.description: Condition where UE is connected to 5GC of the source E-UTRA cell, allowing delta configuration for PDCP and SDAP to be used.

entities.name: Delta configuration for PDCP and SDAP
entities.description: Incremental configuration changes for PDCP and SDAP protocols used during intra-system inter-RAT handover.

UE applies default MAC Cell Group configuration as part of RRC reconfiguration procedure
